scope: ONE real native common GBNF smoke, semantic model control not qualification
grammar:
root ::= "{" ws "\"subject\"" ws ":" ws array ws "," ws "\"teacher\"" ws ":" ws array ws "," ws "\"room\"" ws ":" ws array ws "}"
array ::= "[" ws (id (ws "," ws id){0,47})? ws "]"
ws ::= [ \t\n\r]{0,4}
id ::= "\"g0\"" | "\"g1\"" | "\"g2\"" | "\"g3\"" | "\"g4\"" | "\"g5\"" | "\"g6\""
inferenceScope: Existing genuine production C bridge CPU runtime; one first-case format feasibility smoke only, no new model download or qualification
